prompt.alinti: Don't open Cloud Code again until you install these five skills.
They make it ten times more powerful.
I tested over a hundred skills, and these are the five that I would always use.
First, Super Design. It gives Cloud an actual design canvas, mocks up a few polished directions at once, and hands back real React and Tailwind, so your app stops looking like every other app.

Second, Super Powers. It turns Cloud into a plan-first team that brainstorms, writes the spec, then spins up sub-agents to build, test, and review. And it throws out any code written before the tests exist.

Third, the one almost nobody installs, the Security Audit Skill Control Bits. Cloud runs the same static analysis tool as the pros use, and it flags the real vulnerabilities in your code before you ship, not just a vague warning.
Fourth, the Carpathi Skill. Its whole rule is to touch only what the task needs, so Cloud stops rewriting what it would promote and breaking things it was never asked to.
Fifth, the clever one, the Playwright Skill. Cloud opens a real browser, clicks through what it built, and fixes what breaks, so it checks its own work.
Comment Powers, and I'll DM you the install guide for five.
